sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 4 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Zainul Abdin
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.

This application under Section 529 Bnss has been filed with a prayer to direct the court
concerned to decide the Case No. 30250 of 2023 arising out of case crime no. 36 of 2023, under
Sections 376-D, 506 Ipc, Police Station- Thakurdwara, District- Moradabad pending in the Court of
Chief Judicial Magistrate, Moradabad expeditiously within a stipulated period.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is the informant in the aforesaid case and Court concerned is not taking proper interest to ensure the appearance of the said accused before it.
It is also submitted that the case is still pending at the stage of appearance.

The trial court is not taking any interest for disposal of the case.
4.
I have considered the submissions and perused the entire record.

sentences.text: The trial court is expected to invoke its power to ensure service of process upon the accused persons, which is sent under its seal and order in order to procure the presence of the accused.

6. In the circumstances, the Court concerned is directed to take all possible measures to procure the presence of the accused / opposite parties by sending appropriate process to them within two months from the date of production of certified copy of this order before it and thereafter all endeavours shall be made by it for expeditious disposal of the case, keeping in view the heavy work load in the said Court.

7. It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder of the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and execution authorities, advocates, parties to the case, staff etc. are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
8. With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
